outcome.explanation: Invoice UTL-4412 from Electric Utility is for 2,950.00. That is 1,870.00 above the 1,080.00 average of the last three bills. Over the last six months the bills ran between 1,002.00 and 1,110.00. The invoice also says the charge is based on an estimated meter read, not an actual one. The vendor, its tax ID and its bank account ending 6006 all match the vendor record, and I found no earlier payment of this invoice number. So this doesn't look like fraud or a duplicate, just an unusually high estimate. Please hold the invoice and send the email I drafted, which asks the utility for an actual meter read and a corrected invoice if needed. I saved it as a draft and did not send it. Payment is due in 20 days, so this needs a reply before about 2026-11-26.

email_draft.subject: Invoice UTL-4412 – request for actual meter read
email_draft.body:
Hello,

We received invoice UTL-4412 dated 2026-11-06 for 2,950.00 for electricity at our roastery meter. The invoice says it is based on an estimated meter read. Our last six monthly bills were between 1,002.00 and 1,110.00, and the last three averaged 1,080.00. This invoice is 1,870.00 above that average.

Could you please send us an actual meter read for this period, or confirm the reading, and issue a corrected invoice if needed? Please also explain what the estimate was based on.

Thank you,
Accounts Payable
